body: I watched as the drone continued to hover, its movements slow yet deliberate. The light from inside the building cast eerie shadows on the ground below. My heart pounded in my chest, and I felt an overwhelming urge to run. But something held me back—part of me knew this was just an attempt to capture footage or gather data, not an actual threat. As panic surged within me, I took a deep breath, steadied my nerves, and forced myself to focus on safety rather than fear.
